parameters.destinations: The places, as NavigationRailDestination icons with labels.
parameters.selectedIndex: The index of the current place.
parameters.onDestinationSelected: Called with the index of the chosen place.
parameters.labelType: Shows every label, only the current one, or none.
parameters.extended: Whether the rail widens to show labels beside the icons.
parameters.leading: A widget above the places, such as a FloatingActionButton.
